notes.title: 📢 “Loser Got Isekai’d” Dev Update + Help Wanted 🙏
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629295/fa6f2f331919d3a425e1e71276d2ccd72735a771.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We’re a tiny indie team from Taiwan (fewer than 10 people), and this is our first R18 game: [/p][p]“Loser Got Isekai’d – Gotta Conquer the Girls Before Conquering the World.” [/p][p]It’s all about seducing heroines, mana transfer, and world domination! The demo is now available on Steam!  [/p][p][/p][p]It’s our very first time making a NSFW game, and also our debut on Steam. After consulting many experienced devs, we’ve learned that hitting 8,000 wishlists is the sweet spot for better visibility and traction at launch.  [/p][p][/p][p]Right now, we’ve just reached around 5,000 wishlists, and we still have a ways to go. [/p][p]So we’re here to shamelessly ask for your help 🙇‍♀️:  [/p][p]👉 Love lewd and fun games? [/p][p]👉 Got friends who are also horny heroes? [/p][p]Please share our game, wishlist it, give it a like—it all helps bring us closer to launch!  [/p][p][/p][p]🧪 Once we hit the number, we’re launching right away. [/p][p]🧪 We also have more naughty projects in the works, so if you like our vibe, please stick around!  [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for all your support—and thank you for using your lovely little hands to click that wishlist ❤️  [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3733830/_/"][/dynamiclink]
[/p]

notes.title: This Loser Got Isekai’d the Naughty Way
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629295/a57bca87afd248ed13c74715326a108d3203029f.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]No truck-kun.  
No secret route unlocked.  
I was just... enjoying a bit of alone time in my room.  
And then—Boom. I woke up in another world.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629295/4b17b51d57f26364385e6cd73cfe4de6c00273e8.jpg"][/img]

The first person I met?  
A princess. 👑  
She didn’t ask who I was. She asked if I could command an army.  
And then she asked if I was free *tonight*.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629295/d000ba8917b290c90c43dc30520e27c3e5243288.jpg"][/img]

That’s how my unwilling (but totally awesome) journey began—  
World conquest, goddess-tier waifus, and daily... mana transfer rituals.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629295/cf9e536ecb6df7d7532dfa6351228695e9944dbd.jpg"][/img]

🛏️ **Loser Got Isekai’d – Gotta Conquer the Girls Before Conquering the World**  [/p][p]
A strategic 18+ RPG full of battles, waifus, and naughty upgrades.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629295/e1b38cfec630e8b1a27235ad7200e9fefaf08a74.jpg"][/img]

👉 \[Wishlist on Steam now][/p][p][/p][p] [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3733830/Loser/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]  📌 **Content warning**: Nudity, sexual themes, tactical gameplay, and actual mana charging. [/p]
